name: IBM webMethods Integration v12.1 Developer
desc: This 3-day, hands-on technical course is designed to equip software developers with the foundational and advanced skills required to build, deploy, and manage robust integration solutions using the modernized IBM webMethods Integration platform (versions 11.x and 12.1). Upgrading from legacy architectures, learners master the core webMethods runtime environments—including the Microservices Runtime (MSR) and Service Designer—leveraging Java 21 and Jakarta EE 10 infrastructure. Through practical exercises, participants learn to manage package assets using the webMethods Package Manager (wpm), build complex business logic using Flow constructs, and design structured schemas to process diverse enterprise payloads in JSON, XML, and flat files.
prereq: 1–2 years of software development experience; experience with object-oriented development
Basic familiarity with Eclipse IDE and containerization concepts.
persona: Developer

name: IBM webMethods Integration Server v12.1 Administration (On-Prem)
desc: This instructor-led 4-day training course is designed specifically for system administrators, middleware operators, and technical leads responsible for managing modern IBM webMethods Hybrid Integration environments (v12.1). Participants gain comprehensive, hands-on experience covering essential platform lifecycle duties, from initial installation and fixing applications under IBM Semeru Java runtimes to database schema creation and daily maintenance and operational oversight. Throughout the course, students explore advanced administrative workflows including infrastructure security with corporate SSO and directory integration, performance tuning, Terracotta clustering, and server diagnostics. Additionally, the curriculum addresses modern DevOps practices, equipping administrators to implement version control with Git, configure automated asset build environments (ABE), and streamline application staging and promotion using webMethods Deployer.
prereq: Application and system administration experience
Familiarity with middleware products and solutions
persona: System and Application Administrators, Middleware Operators, Technical Leads, Developers

name: IBM webMethods MFT
desc: This 2-day, hands-on technical course equips integration developers, system administrators, and Trading Networks support professionals with the foundational and advanced skills needed to build, configure, secure, and manage robust managed file transfer (MFT) solutions using IBM webMethods ActiveTransfer version 12.1. Upgrading from legacy architectures, learners master modernizing file exchanges across B2B, Application-to-Application (A2A), cloud, and hybrid enterprise environments. Participants will explore core ActiveTransfer components running on the modernized webMethods Integration Server and Microservices Runtime (MSR) infrastructure, leveraging Java 21 standards and updated security models. Through practical exercises, students learn to set up ActiveTransfer servers, configure multiple file transfer protocols (HTTP/S, FTP/S, SFTP, SCP, and WebDAV), establish virtual folders, manage user permissions, and implement complex event-driven workflows with automated post-processing actions and alerts. The course also covers advanced operational controls including throttling, transfer acceleration, IP security, ActiveTransfer Gateway deployment in DMZ zones, centralized monitoring via My webMethods Server (MWS) / webMethods Command Central, and troubleshooting through underlying log analysis.
prereq: Working familiarity with core file transfer protocols (FTP, SFTP, HTTP/S) and basic network security concepts (TLS/SSL, certificates)
Foundational understanding of enterprise architecture, operating systems (Linux/Windows), and user access control
Basic knowledge of webMethods Integration Server administration is helpful but not mandatory
persona: Integration Developers and System Administrators responsible for file transfer and B2B infrastructures.
webMethods Trading Networks administrators.
Support and operations engineers managing enterprise data pipelines and MFT servers.

name: IBM Cloud Pak for AIOps & NOI Hybrid Architecture
desc: This in-depth course covers the hybrid architecture that combines Netcool Operations Insight (NOI) with IBM Cloud Pak for AIOps to deliver end-to-end, AI-driven IT operations. Across six days, participants install and integrate both platforms, configure event and topology correlation, apply AI/ML-based root cause analysis, and build automated remediation workflows, closing with advanced Netcool Impact policy development and enterprise best practices.
prereq: Basic Linux administration and command-line skills
Understanding of networking concepts, monitoring, and event/alarm management
Familiarity with IBM Netcool Operations Insight, OMNIbus, probes, or WebGUI
Basic knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, and Red Hat OpenShift
Awareness of IT operations processes, incident management, and automation workflows
Useful but not mandatory: experience with ServiceNow, Instana, Ansible, Turbonomic, DB2, REST APIs, LDAP, or SSO
persona: This course is designed for AIOps architects, Netcool/NOI administrators, OpenShift platform administrators, IT operations engineers, site reliability engineers, DevOps teams, and integration specialists responsible for implementing, managing, or supporting hybrid IBM Cloud Pak for AIOps and Netcool Operations Insight environments.

name: IBM webMethods Integration : What’s New in v12.1
desc: In this course, learners gain an understanding of the differences between IBM webMethods Hybrid Integration (IWHI) version 11.1 and 12.1.
prereq: Familiarity with enterprise integration concepts (APIs, messaging, file transfer).
Basic understanding of cloud and on-premises deployment models.
Exposure to REST APIs and JSON/XML data formats.
Basic understanding of authentication/authorization concepts (OAuth, SSO).
Familiarity with container-based deployment is helpful but not required.
persona: Integration Developers, B2B/EDI Specialists, Platform Administrators, Solution Architects

name: IBM Integration Software Overview
desc: This course provides a structured introduction to the IBM Integration software platform. It explains why organisations are moving from traditional enterprise application integration and ESB-based approaches towards flexible hybrid integration models that connect applications, APIs, events, partners, data, and AI-enabled services across cloud and on-premises environments. Learners explore the platform’s strategic role, deployment choices, high-level architecture, core capabilities, and approach to secure, governed enterprise AI.
prereq: Familiarity with enterprise integration concepts (APIs, messaging, file transfer).
Basic understanding of cloud and on-premises deployment models.
Exposure to REST APIs and JSON/XML data formats.
Basic understanding of authentication/authorization concepts (OAuth, SSO).
Familiarity with container-based deployment is helpful but not required.
persona: Integration Developers, B2B/EDI Specialists, Platform Administrators, Solution Architects

name: IBM webMethods API Management
desc: This comprehensive 3-day instructor-led training provides integration developers, API architects, and platform administrators with the end-to-end technical skills required to design, secure, virtualize, manage, and govern enterprise APIs using the on-premises IBM webMethods API Management v12.1 platform. This course addresses the enterprise shift following IBM’s acquisition and convergence of webMethods technology. The course focuses on on-premises deployment topologies, detailing the architecture of webMethods API Gateway and webMethods Developer Portal, while introducing deep integration and federated governance patterns with IBM API Connect. Participants will gain practical, production-ready experience through scenario-driven lab exercises running in an isolated on-premises runtime environment.
prereq: Fundamental understanding of RESTful architecture, HTTP methods, and JSON/XML data formats.
Familiarity with standard Web Services concepts (SOAP, WSDL) and API security fundamentals (Basic Authentication, API Keys, OAuth 2.0, SSL/TLS).
Basic networking concepts (DMZ, reverse proxy, reverse routing).
persona: API Developers and Integration Developers
API Product Managers and API Administrators
Enterprise Integration Architects and System Administrators

name: IBM Integration Software Overview Lite
desc: In this course, learners gain an understanding of the IBM webMethods Hybrid Integration (IWHI) platform architecture, core capabilities, hybrid deployment strategies, and the integration of enterprise AI.
prereq: Familiarity with enterprise integration concepts (APIs, messaging, file transfer).
Basic understanding of cloud and on-premises deployment models.
Exposure to REST APIs and JSON/XML data formats.
Basic understanding of authentication/authorization concepts (OAuth, SSO).
Familiarity with container-based deployment is helpful but not required.
persona: Integration Developers, B2B/EDI Specialists, Platform Administrators, Solution Architects

name: IBM webMethods Integration & Cloud Consoles V12.1 Administrator
desc: This 1-hour stand-alone add-on course equips system administrators and middleware operators with the essential skills required to operate and govern modern IBM webMethods Integration environments across hybrid and cloud-native topologies. Building upon core on-premises administration, learners explore how the IBM SaaS Console and boundary control plane deliver unified oversight across distributed runtime landscapes. The curriculum focuses on federated visibility, hybrid security governance, and multi-cloud runtime management. Participants will explore centralized subscription management, environment provisioning, and access controls via IBMid Enterprise Federation (SAML 2.0). The course also demonstrates federated API management across diverse gateways, connectivity to on-premises Integration Server (IS) and Microservices Runtime (MSR) engines, secure VPC private networking, and centralized governance over enterprise AI models. By the end of this training, administrators will understand how to orchestrate, monitor, and protect distributed integration estates from a single SaaS control plane.
prereq: Foundational experience with IBM webMethods Integration Server administration (or completion of the webMethods Integration Platform Administration Workshop).
Familiarity with enterprise middleware architectures, HTTP/REST communications, and API concepts.
Basic understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts, identity federation (SAML/SSO), and virtual private networking (AWS VPC / Azure VNet).
persona: System and Application Administrators
Middleware Operators and Technical Leads
Integration Architects and DevOps Engineers

name: IBM Business Automation Workflow v25: Advanced Process Design and Integration
desc: This 1-day instructor-led course covers advanced workflow development using IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) 25.0.1. Participants will learn to design sophisticated workflow patterns, integrate processes with external systems, and build event-driven, scalable automation solutions.
prereq: Working knowledge of IBM BAW or BPM fundamentals
Prior hands-on experience building BAW process applications
Basic understanding of REST/SOAP web services
persona: Application Developers
Workflow Developers
BPM/BAW Solution Architects
Integration Developers
Technical Consultants
System Integrators
Process Automation Specialists

name: IBM Business Automation Workflow Foundations
desc: IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) combines business process management and case management to automate complex work. This program pairs two days of in-person training on designing process applications, coaches, and complex interactions with six virtual sessions covering case management, routing, integrations, monitoring, reporting, and governance best practices. This course can be delivered as a 4 day course with 6x2 hour online sessions for follow up topics (customised to what the client needs).
prereq: Basic understanding of business process and workflow concepts. Familiarity with enterprise applications, user roles/permissions, and system integration principles is beneficial. No prior IBM BAW experience is required, although awareness of BPM or case management concepts would be helpful.
persona: Business analysts, process designers, solution architects, application developers, technical consultants, and support teams involved in designing, building, integrating, or managing IBM Business Automation Workflow solutions.

name: Planning Analytics End User Training
desc: Introduces business users, planners, and analysts to IBM Planning Analytics and TM1 fundamentals. Participants learn to navigate Planning Analytics Workspace (PAW), work with cubes and dimensions, enter planning data, create reports and dashboards, perform variance and what-if analysis, and collaborate using PAW.
persona: Business Users, Analysts, Finance Users, Planners

name: Planning Analytics Workspace (PAW) Advanced User Training
desc: Designed for power users and financial analysts who need to create advanced dashboards, reports, workflows, and forecasting models. The course covers advanced PAW capabilities including dynamic reporting, action buttons, predictive forecasting, AI-assisted planning, and performance optimization.
persona: Power Users, Financial Analysts, Departmental Super Users

name: Planning Analytics for Excel (PAfE)
desc: Focuses on integrating IBM Planning Analytics with Microsoft Excel. Participants learn to create dynamic reports, active forms, financial models, management dashboards, and leverage TM1 worksheet functions for advanced reporting and analysis.
persona: Excel Power Users, Finance Teams

name: Planning Analytics Administrator
desc: Provides administrators and support teams with the knowledge required to install, configure, secure, maintain, and optimize Planning Analytics environments. Topics include architecture, security administration, cube and dimension management, TurboIntegrator (TI), performance tuning, backup/recovery, and troubleshooting.
persona: System Administrators, TM1 Administrators, Support Teams

name: IBM Datacap Administration: Document Capture System Setup and Management
desc: This 3-day instructor-led course covers IBM Datacap administration for enterprise document capture. Participants will gain the practical skills needed to install, configure, secure, and maintain a Datacap environment, and to support high-volume document capture operations in production settings.
prereq: Familiarity with document capture concepts and general system administration experience (Windows/Linux) is recommended prior to attending this course.
persona: System administrators, IT support staff, and technical professionals responsible for managing IBM Datacap environments
Individuals tasked with maintaining system health, configuring users, and ensuring smooth capture operations
Anyone involved in deploying or supporting document capture infrastructure

name: IBM Cognos Version 12 Advanced Administration
desc: This advanced course equips administrators to run a secure, reliable and high-performing IBM Cognos Analytics 12 platform. Participants examine the Version 12 architecture, carry out distributed installation and configuration, integrate enterprise authentication and single sign-on, and design a role-based security model. Later modules cover high availability, performance tuning, monitoring and auditing, content deployment, upgrading from 11.x, and automating routine tasks with the REST API, ending with a hands-on troubleshooting scenario. Outcome: Learners leave able to install, secure, tune, monitor, migrate and troubleshoot a multi-server Cognos Analytics 12 environment.
prereq: Hands-on experience administering Cognos Analytics 11.x or 12 (portal administration, basic security, scheduling). Working knowledge of Windows or Linux server administration, web servers, LDAP/Active Directory and relational databases. Familiarity with report authoring at RSF-01 level is helpful.
persona: Cognos administrators, platform/infrastructure engineers and BI team leads responsible for production Cognos environments.

name: IBM Cognos Version 12 Advanced Report Building
desc: This advanced course takes experienced authors beyond standard reports to tackle the complex requirements found in real organisations. Participants work with multiple and derived queries, master-detail layouts, dimensional functions, prompt macros and active reports, and learn to burst a single report to many recipients. The course also covers the authoring changes in Version 12 and practical techniques for diagnosing and tuning slow reports, so learners can build sophisticated reports that are fast, reusable and easy to maintain. Outcome: Learners leave able to design complex, high-performing, reusable reports using advanced queries, dimensional functions, interactivity and bursting.
prereq: Course RSF or equivalent (6+ months building list, crosstab, chart and prompted reports). Working knowledge of SQL joins and aggregation. Basic understanding of dimensional concepts (dimensions, hierarchies, levels, members) is recommended.
persona: Experienced report authors, BI developers and power users who already build standard reports and need to handle complex business requirements.

name: IBM Cognos Analytics Dashboard Development
desc: This practical course shows analysts and developers how to turn data into interactive dashboards and visual stories in IBM Cognos Analytics. Participants start by preparing data in data modules, then build dashboards with well-chosen visualisations, connected filters, calculations and navigation paths. They also explore the AI-assisted features for asking questions in plain language and finding key drivers, and learn the design, accessibility, sharing and governance practices that make dashboards clear, trusted and widely used. Outcome: Learners leave able to model data in data modules and build interactive, well-designed dashboards and stories that others can use and trust.
prereq: Basic data literacy (measures, categories, aggregation). Familiarity with Excel or another BI/visualisation tool is helpful. No authoring experience required; RSF-01 is a useful primer.
persona: Business analysts, managers and BI developers who need to create self-service dashboards and visual stories; report authors adding dashboards to their skill set.

name: IBM Cognos Report Studio Author Professional Reports Fundamentals
desc: This hands-on foundation course introduces report authors to IBM Cognos Analytics and its professional authoring tool, Reporting (formerly Report Studio). Over three days, participants learn to build list, crosstab and chart reports, then make them useful and polished with filters, calculations, prompts, conditional formatting and drill-through. The course closes with running, scheduling and distributing reports, so learners leave ready to produce accurate, well-presented reports that colleagues can rely on, and with a solid base for the advanced authoring, dashboard and OLAP courses.
prereq: Comfortable with Windows and a web browser; basic understanding of business data (tables, fields, totals). SQL knowledge is helpful but not required. No prior Cognos experience needed.
persona: Business and technical report authors, analysts moving from self-service tools into managed reporting, and developers new to Cognos.

name: IBM Cognos Transformer OLAP
desc: This course teaches BI developers and modellers to design and build multidimensional PowerCubes with IBM Cognos Transformer. Participants create models from packages and flat files, design dimensions, levels, time structures and measures, and learn to optimise cube size and build times. The course also covers securing cubes with custom views, publishing them as packages, automating nightly builds, and deciding when to keep, migrate or modernise existing Transformer models within a Cognos Analytics 12 environment. Outcome: Learners leave able to design, build, secure, publish and maintain PowerCubes with Cognos Transformer for use in Cognos Analytics.
prereq: Understanding of dimensional modelling (facts, dimensions, hierarchies). Working SQL knowledge. Familiarity with Cognos packages (RSF-01 or equivalent). Access to Transformer installed on a Windows workstation.
persona: BI developers, data modellers and OLAP/cube specialists; administrators responsible for scheduled cube builds.

name: IBM DataStage NextGen on IBM Cloud Pak for Data
desc: This course is designed those who have worked in DataStage legacy versions and other ETL tools. It begins with introducing the new interface for DataStage: the DataStage Flow. The course covers commonly used stages, cloud connecters, advanced connectors and new features available in DataStage Nextgen on IBM watsonx.data Integration.
prereq: Basic understanding of ETL concepts
Basic familiarity with Cloud services is preferred
Basic knowledge of Database and SQL is preferred
persona: This Course is designed for users that are new to watsonx.data Integration using DataStage Nextgen

name: IBM DataStage-aaS Anywhere Developers
desc: This comprehensive course empowers you to master data integration and transformation pipelines. You'll efficiently manage DataStage Flows, handle file and data processing stages, and seamlessly connect to cloud and database connectors. Learn to automate pipelines with Watson Pipelines, ensuring optimized performance and streamlined data workflows. By the end of this course, you'll be equipped with the skills to handle parallel frameworks, multi-instance jobs, and advanced data transformations. This is a 4-day instructor-led course, conducted over 5 hours per day.
prereq: Basic understanding of data integration or ETL concepts
Familiarity with SQL and relational databases
General knowledge of Cloud Pak for Data (helpful, not required)
persona: This course is appropriate for learners new to DataStage, as well as experienced DataStage users who are new to DataStage as a Service on Cloud Pak for Data.

name: DataStage Platform Administration on IBM Cloud Pak for Data
desc: Do you want to become an expert in managing IBM Cloud Pak for Data and DataStage? This course equips you to efficiently manage IBM Cloud Pak for Data and DataStage, covering user management, storage handling, platform monitoring, and dynamic workload management, while diving deep into the parallel framework architecture.
prereq: Basic familiarity with IBM Cloud Pak for Data
General system or platform administration experience
Working knowledge of DataStage fundamentals
persona: DataStage Administrators

name: Data Virtualization on IBM Cloud Pak for Data V5.1
desc: Are you ready to unlock the full potential of your data? Learn how to harness the power of IBM Data Virtualization to seamlessly virtualize data from multiple sources, streamline access management, and optimize query performance. This hands-on training will equip you with the skills to create virtual objects, manage data connections, and leverage advanced caching strategies for faster insights. Elevate your data-driven decision-making with the cutting-edge capabilities of Data Virtualization.
prereq: Basic understanding of SQL and relational data concepts
Familiarity with data sources, connections, and catalogs
General awareness of data governance and access management principles
persona: This course is designed for business users, business analysts, data stewards, governance users, data quality analysts, data scientists, catalog administrators, metadata administrators, data engineers, and developers.

name: IBM Databand for DataStage on IBM Cloud Pak for Data
desc: Are you looking to gain deeper insights into your data pipelines and enhance monitoring capabilities? This course provides a comprehensive understanding of Databand, from managing users and exploring dashboards to integrating with DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data and configuring alerts. You'll also learn how to analyze datasets and export metadata, empowering you to optimize performance and make data-driven decisions with ease.
prereq: Basic familiarity with data pipelines and ETL concepts
Working knowledge of IBM DataStage or Cloud Pak for Data
General understanding of data monitoring and alerting concepts
persona: The target audience for this course includes data analysts, data engineers, business intelligence professionals, IT professionals involved in data management, and anyone interested in harnessing the power of data for insights and decision-making.

name: IBM DataStage-aaS Anywhere Administration
desc: This course is designed to enable and equip users to perform administration of DataStage- aaS Anywhere with remote engine. Parallel framework architecture will be discussed in detail along with the platform administration.
prereq: Linux, Datastage Foundation
persona: Administrators

name: IBM Knowledge Catalog
desc: This course equips you with the knowledge to effectively manage user roles and permissions, implement governance artifacts, and handle metadata within an enterprise environment. Learn how to configure workflows, enforce data protection rules, and leverage advanced features like global search and data exploration. With hands-on practice and expert guidance, you'll gain the skills to efficiently manage and protect your organization's data assets.
prereq: Basic familiarity with IBM Cloud Pak for Data
General understanding of data governance and metadata management concepts
Working knowledge of data sources, connections, and cataloging principles
persona: The target audience for IBM Knowledge Catalog training includes business users and analysts, data engineers and stewards, and governance users who aim to enhance data management, governance, and collaboration within their organization.

name: InfoSphere QualityStage 11.7 Developers (Windows)
desc: This course empowers you to leverage IBM QualityStage to identify and resolve data quality contaminants, standardize data, and effectively match and consolidate records. Learn how to build and run QualityStage jobs, create custom rule sets, and refine match criteria to improve data accuracy. With hands-on experience in investigation, standardization, and survivorship processes, you'll gain the skills needed to deliver high-quality, reliable data for better business decisions.
prereq: Basic familiarity with data quality and data cleansing concepts
General understanding of IBM DataStage or a similar ETL tool
Basic knowledge of relational data structures
persona: The audience for this course includes new QualityStage developers, data analysts responsible for data quality, data cleansing developers, and data quality developers looking to create match specifications.

name: InfoSphere DataStage 11.7 Developers (Windows & Linux)
desc: This updated course empowers you to efficiently design and manage data flows using DataStage 11.7. Learn to work with advanced stages, leverage cloud-based connectors, and implement powerful features like Change Capture and Surrogate Key Generation. With in-depth training on cloud platforms like Amazon S3, Google BigQuery, and Snowflake, you'll optimize job performance and streamline data management.
prereq: Basic understanding of data integration or ETL concepts
Familiarity with SQL and relational databases
General computer literacy with Windows or Linux environments
persona: This training is designed for DataStage Developers, ETL Developers, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists, along with Data Stewards, Data Quality Analysts, Application Developers, and Database Developers who work with data integration and transformation.

name: InfoSphere Information Analyzer 11.7 Developers
desc: This updated course provides hands-on training in InfoSphere Information Analyzer 11.7, helping you analyze, classify, and manage data effectively. Learn how to set up data connections, perform column and table analyses, and generate insightful reports. Master data rule creation, automation, and migration to improve consistency and governance. Understand key metrics, exception handling, and best practices for large-scale rule execution.
prereq: Basic understanding of data integration or data quality concepts
Familiarity with SQL and relational databases
General awareness of IBM Information Server or Cloud Pak for Data (helpful, not required)
persona: This training is designed for DataStage Developers, ETL Developers, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists, along with Data Stewards, Data Quality Analysts, Application Developers, and Database Developers who work with data integration and transformation.

name: IBM Cloud Pak for Data Platform and Cluster Administration
desc: This course is designed to enable and equip users to perform Cluster Administration on IBM Red Hat OpenShift and Platform Administration on IBM Cloud Pak for Data.
prereq: Linux Administration skills is preferred. OpenShift Basics are required.
persona: This Course is designed for users that work on IBM Cloud Pak for Data platform and cluster administration

name: InfoSphere FastTrack 11.7
desc: This hands-on course will teach you how to leverage IBM InfoSphere FastTrack 11.7 to streamline data integration and automation. Learn to import metadata, create mapping specifications, and generate DataStage jobs effortlessly. Explore advanced techniques like switch constraints, filters, and transformations to fine-tune your mappings. Reverse-engineer DataStage jobs, generate insightful reports, and automate processes using the istool utility.
prereq: Basic understanding of data integration or ETL concepts
Familiarity with IBM InfoSphere DataStage fundamentals
General knowledge of source-to-target data mapping
persona: This training is designed for ETL Developers, Data Engineers, Data Architects, and Business Analysts who need to streamline data mapping, transformation, and automation using IBM InfoSphere FastTrack 11.7.

name: InfoSphere Information Governance Catalog 11.7 Developers
desc: This four-day course covers IBM InfoSphere Information Governance Catalog (IGC) V11.7 in depth, from business categories, terms, and policies through metadata import, lineage, and impact analysis. Participants also work with the IGC REST API, the istool migration utility, and the platform's newest features, including guidance on migrating to Watson Knowledge Catalog.
prereq: Foundational knowledge of data governance and databases. InfoSphere familiarity, basic technical skills, and optional REST API knowledge.
persona: Developers, Data governance, data management, and IT professionals who use or support IGC

name: Data Quality Lifecycle using IBM Cloud Pak for Data (on prem)
desc: This four-day course covers the full data quality lifecycle within IBM Knowledge Catalog on IBM Cloud Pak for Data, from governance artifacts and data curation through building data quality rules and using Data Refinery for hands-on data cleansing. Participants leave able to measure, monitor, and improve the trustworthiness of enterprise data.
prereq: Basic familiarity with relational data concepts (tables, columns, data types) and general comfort with web-based enterprise applications.
persona: This course is designed for data stewards, data governance professionals, catalog administrators, and data engineers who curate, govern, and improve the quality of enterprise data. Data analysts and other data consumers will also benefit from the governance and discovery content.

name: IBM Data Refinery on Cloud Pak for Data
desc: Are you ready to take control of your data refinery and data governance with IBM Cloud Pak for Data? Get hands-on with IBM Cloud Pak for Data and take charge of data refinery and governance! In this course, you'll learn to refine data, create and run data refinery jobs, handle data requests, and collaborate on governance artifacts. You'll also explore services, manage users and roles, implement data protection rules, and organize catalogs, projects, and workflows.
prereq: Basic familiarity with IBM Cloud Pak for Data
General understanding of data governance and cataloging concepts
Basic knowledge of working with tabular data (spreadsheets or simple SQL queries)
persona: This course is designed for Business Users, Business Analysts, Data Stewards, Governance Users, Data Quality Analysts, Data Scientists, Catalog Administrators, Metadata Administrators, Data Engineers, and Developers looking to enhance their data refinery, data governance, and management skills with IBM Cloud Pak for Data.

name: MettleCI for DataStage on IBM Cloud Pak for Data
desc: This course will guide you through test specification development, automated creation and execution, and unit testing with real-world DataStage jobs. Discover how to intercept test data, refine workflows, and optimize performance with MettleCI's powerful features. Gain hands-on experience to confidently implement best practices and accelerate your DataStage development process.
prereq: Working knowledge of IBM DataStage job development
Basic familiarity with software testing concepts
General understanding of version control (Git) and CI/CD principles
persona: This training is for DataStage developers, DevOps engineers, and QA professionals looking to automate testing, integrate Git, and streamline CI/CD workflows with MettleCI.

name: IBM Db2 Federation Administration: Setup, Security and Performance Tuning
desc: This 3-day instructor-led course provides skills to configure, administer, and optimize IBM Db2 Federation systems. Participants will learn to integrate and manage data across heterogeneous data sources, secure federated connections, and tune query performance for enterprise environments.
prereq: Working knowledge of IBM Db2 database administration
Familiarity with SQL and relational database concepts
General understanding of heterogeneous data source integration
persona: Database administrators, developers, and systems engineers working with or planning to implement IBM Db2 Federation
Professionals responsible for integrating data across heterogeneous environments
Technical leads, architects, and performance tuning specialists, who will also benefit from the advanced topics covered

name: IBM Db2 Federation Developer: Federated Query Writing and Optimization
desc: This 2-day advanced workshop covers federated query development in IBM Db2. What You Will Learn • Write simple to complex federated SQL queries across heterogeneous data sources • Monitor query execution performance and interpret EXPLAIN output • Apply pushdown operations for multi-source join optimization • Troubleshoot federated query issues in distributed environments
prereq: Working knowledge of IBM Db2 Federation configuration and administration
Strong familiarity with SQL, including joins, subqueries, and query tuning
General experience with heterogeneous or distributed database environments
persona: Database developers, administrators, and data engineers

name: DB2 Warehouse Gen 3 (OpenShift) for Administrators
desc: This 3-day instructor-led course provides in-depth skills for optimizing Db2 Warehouse Gen 3 on Red Hat OpenShift. Participants will learn to tune SQL performance, manage containerized workloads, secure data, and configure federation for cross-database access. What You Will Learn • Optimize SQL query performance through indexing, partitioning, and execution plan analysis • Manage resource allocation and workload balancing in containerized Db2 Warehouse • Secure data with SSL/TLS encryption and role-based access • Configure federation for cross-database data access • Troubleshoot performance bottlenecks and perform version upgrades
prereq: Working knowledge of IBM Db2 database administration
Basic familiarity with Red Hat OpenShift and containerized environments
Strong understanding of SQL performance tuning concepts
persona: This course is intended for data engineers, database administrators, and system architects who work with Db2 Warehouse Gen 3 and are responsible for optimizing performance and designing scalable data solutions.

name: DB2 Warehouse Gen 3 (OpenShift) for Developers
desc: This 2-day instructor-led course equips developers with advanced SQL skills for Db2 Warehouse Gen 3 on Red Hat OpenShift. What You Will Learn • Apply advanced SQL functions for data transformation, aggregation, and reporting • Work with Data Lake tables for hybrid data access patterns • Optimize complex SQL queries for performance • Troubleshoot query execution issues and interpret explain plans
prereq: Strong working knowledge of SQL, including joins, subqueries, and aggregate functions
Prior experience writing and running queries against Db2 or a similar relational database
Basic familiarity with Db2 Warehouse Gen 3 or Red Hat OpenShift environments
persona: This course is intended for developers who work with Db2 Warehouse Gen 3 and are responsible for optimizing and designing SQL queries.

name: Watson Query for TIBCO Data Virtualization Replacement: Migration Use Cases
desc: This 2.5-day instructor-led course guides teams through migrating from TIBCO Data Virtualization to Watson Query on IBM Cloud Pak for Data. What You Will Learn • Replace TIBCO web services with Db2Rest endpoints • Build and optimize Db2 stored procedures for complex data transformations • Virtualize heterogeneous data sources including SAP HANA, Oracle, and MSSQL • Configure security, access control, and performance tuning
prereq: Working experience with TIBCO Data Virtualization or a similar data virtualization platform
Strong SQL skills, including writing and optimizing stored procedures
Familiarity with heterogeneous database systems such as SAP HANA, Oracle, or MSSQL
persona: Developers and architects experienced with TIBCO DV, SAP HANA, Oracle, MSSQL, or general SQL
Data administrators focused on monitoring, scaling, and securing data virtualization environments

name: IBM InfoSphere Master Data Management (MDM) Standard Edition: Architecture and Development
desc: This instructor-led course provides a deep dive into IBM InfoSphere MDM architecture and development. What You Will Learn • Understand InfoSphere MDM architecture, including the Request/Response Framework and OSGi packaging • Build Virtual data model customizations and Composite Services • Configure Adaptive Service Interface (ASI) services and interaction handlers • Extend MDM behavior using the Workbench development environment
prereq: Working knowledge of Java and object-oriented development
Basic familiarity with IBM InfoSphere MDM or master data management concepts
General understanding of web services and service-oriented architecture (SOA)
persona: MDM developers, technical consultants, and solution architects working in data management and application development.

name: IBM InfoSphere MDM Workbench Training: Customization and Extension
desc: This 3-day instructor-led course covers the MDM Workbench for customizing IBM InfoSphere MDM. What You Will Learn • Build data additions, extensions, and behavior extensions • Create and deploy composite services with OSGi packaging • Configure Virtual MDM, interaction handlers, and ASI services • Deploy customizations across Physical, Virtual, and Hybrid MDM
prereq: Working knowledge of Java and object-oriented development

name: IBM Z Workload Scheduler (ZWS) Programming Language Training
desc: This instructor-led course teaches IBM Z Workload Scheduler (ZWS) Programming Language (PL) for automating and customizing batch workflows on mainframe systems. Over two days, participants learn to create, modify, and optimize PL scripts that streamline enterprise scheduling operations. What you will learn: • Build and troubleshoot ZWS PL scripts for application descriptions, recovery logic, and event-driven scheduling • Link JCL using symbolic parameters, workstation routing, and ISPF panels • Integrate ZWS with CICS, DB2, and MQ for enterprise batch automation • Use operator commands and ISPF panels to monitor and control workflows Who should attend: Mainframe developers, system programmers, workload automation administrators, and IT operations teams responsible for batch job orchestration on IBM Z.
prereq: Basic understanding of mainframe concepts, IBM Z environment, or enterprise batch processing.
Familiarity with JCL (Job Control Language) and job scheduling fundamentals.
Prior exposure to workload automation tools (optional but helpful).
persona: Mainframe developers and system programmers working with IBM Z scheduling environments. Workload automation administrators who want to customize and automate scheduling logic using PL. IT operations and support teams responsible for batch job orchestration, automation, and optimization.

name: IBM DataStage NextGen on IBM Cloud Pak for Data v4.9
desc: This course is designed those who have worked in DataStage legacy versions and other ETL tools. It begins with introducing the new interface for DataStage: the DataStage Flow. The course covers commonly used stages, cloud connecters, advanced connectors and new features available in DataStage Nextgen on IBM watsonx.data Integration.
prereq: Basic understanding of ETL concepts
Basic familiarity with Cloud services is preferred
Basic knowledge of Database and SQL is preferred
persona: users that are new to watsonx.data Integration using DataStage Nextgen
